annotations.text:
Four surfaces, one language:
· BILLING — the last old-style platform page. Stat tiles keep the shared card look; plans become cards (price big, limits as chips); subscriptions become studio rows with honest Past-due states. ⚠ the plan data model is known-stale (3 price lists disagree, Stripe scaffold dead) — figures here are SAMPLES; reconcile pricing before wiring.
· ORDERS — the page chrome is already modern; this redesigns the ROWS: to-send orders get the amber edge and the only button (Send it), everything else is a quiet status chip. Payment method spelled out (MoMo paid / Cash on delivery).
· NOTIFICATION SETTINGS — each event gets a picture tile; channels are tick-pills, not tiny switches; always-on events stated in words up top. Quiet hours in one row.
· BUYER ACCOUNT — default Market theme. Orders become cards with a mini delivery tracker (same picture as the merchant setup journey). ⚠ this page renders per-theme; build targets the default template first.
